newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine conference delegates may have to float.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine conference delegates may have to float.

text.p: Some delegates may have to stay on boats rather than in hotels when they descend on Ukraine's capital next May for the annual meeting of the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development.
Kiev, an ancient city with a population of three million, still suffers from a chronic shortage of top-class hotels nearly six years after Ukraine's independence,
"We have considered it and are considering using river boats refurbished as part of an EBRD project a couple of years ago," the bank's Secretary-General Antonio Costa told a news conference.

City officials who will have to accommodate nearly 5,000 EBRD deleates are hurrying to renovate more than a dozen Soviet-era hotels in and around the centre of Kiev, which is bisected by the Dnepr river.
But Costa noted that the EBRD also used floating hotels when it met in Russia's second city, St Petersburg, in 1993.
